records.label: spacr.attribution.chefer_relevance#1
records.source: Rollout multiplies raw attention and so gives one map whatever class is asked about. This weights every head's attention by the class score's gradient on it, keeps the positive part, averages the heads and accumulates the result through the residual stream, ``R <- R + A_bar R`` from the identity. The class token's row of ``R`` is the relevance of each patch *for the target class*, so asking for the other class gives a different map.

The class token's row of ``R`` is the relevance of each patch *for the target class*, so asking for the other class gives a different map.
records.translation: 注意力展开将原始注意力相乘，因此无论询问哪个类别都只给出同一张图。本方法用类别得分对每个注意力头的注意力的梯度对其加权，保留正值部分，对各头取平均，并从单位矩阵出发沿残差流累积结果，即 ``R <- R + A_bar R``。``R`` 中类别 token 所在的行就是每个图块 *针对目标类别* 的相关性，因此询问另一个类别会得到不同的图。

records.source: **The diameter.**  :mod:`spacr.diameter` measures characteristic object size from a handful of the user's own fields, without loading Cellpose or torch. ``diameter`` is the single most consequential Cellpose 4 setting spaCR exposes — ``CellposeModel.eval(diameter=...)`` rescales every image by ``30/diameter`` so objects land near the size ``cpsam`` works at — and it is the one users guess at.  The panel this module builds turns the guess into a measurement, per object type, and shows how many objects it measured so the number can be disbelieved.  It opens in a popup of its own from the *Measure diameters…* button in Mask generation's Model zoo popup (item 533), next to the choice of model it is the other half of, rather than on the main screen.
records.context: **The diameter.**  :mod:`spacr.diameter` measures characteristic object size from a handful of the user's own fields, without loading Cellpose or torch. ``diameter`` is the single most consequential Cellpose 4 setting spaCR exposes — ``CellposeModel.eval(diameter=...)`` rescales every image by ``30/diameter`` so objects land near the size ``cpsam`` works at — and it is the one users guess at.  The panel this module builds turns the guess into a measurement, per object type, and shows how many objects it measured so the number can be disbelieved.  It opens in a popup of its own from the *Measure diameters…* button in Mask generation's Model zoo popup (item 533), next to the choice of model it is the other half of, rather than on the main application view.
records.translation: **直径。**  :mod:`spacr.diameter` 根据用户自己的少量视野测量对象的特征大小，无需加载 Cellpose 或 torch。``diameter`` 是 spaCR 公开的 Cellpose 4 设置中影响最大的一项——``CellposeModel.eval(diameter=...)`` 会按 ``30/diameter`` 缩放每张图像，使对象接近 ``cpsam`` 的工作尺寸——而它恰恰是用户靠猜的那一项。  本模块构建的面板把猜测变成按对象类型进行的测量，并显示测量了多少个对象，以便对该数值提出质疑。  它从 Mask generation 的 Model zoo 弹出窗口中的 *Measure diameters…* 按钮打开，位于自己的弹出窗口中（条目 533），紧挨着与它互为另一半的模型选择，而不是放在主界面上。

records.label: spacr.utils.adjust_cell_masks#8
records.source: optional separate folder for adjusted masks. None preserves the historical in-place behavior. A separate folder keeps all source masks byte-identical, and every selected field is rebuilt from its source on each invocation, including after interrupted work. In place, each adjusted mask's SHA-256 is recorded in :data:`ADJUSTED_CELLS_LEDGER` as it lands, and a mask whose bytes still match its record is left alone on the next run: adjusting an adjusted mask merges it again, so a re-run used to change the result every time. A cell mask segmented again no longer matches and is adjusted afresh.
records.context: optional separate folder for adjusted masks. None preserves the historical in-place behavior. A separate folder keeps all source masks byte-identical, and every selected microscope field of view is rebuilt from its source on each invocation, including after interrupted work. In place, each adjusted mask's SHA-256 is recorded in :data:`ADJUSTED_CELLS_LEDGER` as it lands, and a mask whose bytes still match its record is left alone on the next run: adjusting an adjusted mask merges it again, so a repeat execution used to change the result every time. A cell mask segmented again no longer matches and is adjusted afresh.
records.translation: 用于存放调整后掩膜的可选独立文件夹。None 保留过去的就地修改行为。使用独立文件夹时，所有源掩膜保持逐字节不变，并且每个选定视野在每次调用时都从其源重建，包括在工作中断之后。就地修改时，每个调整后掩膜的 SHA-256 会在写入时记录到 :data:`ADJUSTED_CELLS_LEDGER` 中，而字节仍与其记录相符的掩膜在下一次运行时会保持不动：对已调整的掩膜再次调整会再次合并它，因此过去重复运行每次都会改变结果。重新分割的细胞掩膜将不再相符，并会重新调整。
records.review_basis: written from the English (no current MT draft)
